JordanRachel RoseBearport Publishing by Flutterbee, 2025 - Juvenile Nonfiction - 24 pagesFrom throwing punches on the big screen to taking charge behind the camera, Michael B. Jordan is following his dreams. He got his first job as a child model when he was just 10 years old. His career slowly grew as he began acting in TV shows and movies. Soon, he was landing lead roles in hit films. But that's not all for this star! Michael started his own production company so he could help bring more diversity to Hollywood. He uses his platform to speak out for physical and mental health. Learn all about Michael B. Jordan's journey as an actor, producer, and more.
